svg.title: A-101 First Floor Plan
svg.text: OPENABLE WINDOWS TO EAST BOUNDARY 1.60 / 0.90 / 0.60 m
Masonry wall cut by section — 200 mm
Internal stud or block partition, 120 mm
Single leaf door, swing shown to opening side
Glazed opening — arched head where noted
Element above the cut plane (pergola, slab
1. The front terrace and the master balcony are enclosed by a
1.10 m high parapet pierced by traditional arched brick
openings; arch heads are shown dashed.
2. Terrace finish is 30 mm below internal floor level,
falling 1:80 to outlets at the parapet.
3. The master suite occupies block B with the bedroom on the
garden side; the dressing room is daylit from the light
4. East boundary openings: the adjoining plot is limited to
3.00 m in height, so the east wall is opened above that
level. The master bedroom cross ventilates between the
balcony and its east window, and the ensuite and linen
5. Openings in a boundary wall are subject to local fire
separation and rights of light rules; confirm before
6. All bedroom doors give 900 mm clear opening, and the
landing holds a 1.10 m clear route to the stair.
Preliminary design issue — not for construction.
Do not scale; work to figured dimensions only.
